verdict.rationale: The axis applies: this is an online government portal with user accounts (PBS) and stored filings, so a buyer could fairly ask about data retention or deletion controls. The evidence covers only legal record actions, such as dissolving entities, terminating name reservations and terminating financing statements, which change public-record status rather than give users control over how their data is retained or deleted. No retention policy, account deletion or data-erasure capability appears anywhere in the pack.
